entries.text:
I THOUGHT IT WAS
HERE... NICE POOL.
STILL APRIL, SO
NOBODY'S SWIMMING.
SPLAAASH!

WHOA! WHAT?! SOMEONE
JUST CAME OUT OF THE
POOL!

(W-WHAT'S WITH THIS
GUY?!)

...ARE YOU A NEW
STUDENT?

Y-YES. UM... I'M
LOOKING FOR THE CLUB
BUILDING...

...THE CLUB
BUILDING... OVER
THERE.

(FOLLOWING HIS GAZE,
I SEE WHAT MUST BE
THE CLUB
BUILDING...)

TH-THANK YOU! WELL,
I'LL BE GOING!

WHEW... WHO WAS THAT
GUY, ANYWAY?

OH, IT'S SHOMA'S BIG
BROTHER, SHUICHI.
HELLO, SHUICHI!

HEY, {0}{1}{2}. WHY
THE RUSH?

I MET A WEIRD GUY AT
THE POOL. SWIMMING
THIS TIME OF YEAR...
HE'S A BIT ODD.

HMM, A WEIRD GUY?
HOW WEIRD ARE WE
TALKING?

THAT WEIRD... HUH?
BEHIND ME?! WHOA!

COME ON, NAGARE.
DON'T SCARE THE NEW
STUDENTS.

...I... WASN'T
TRYING TO...

(HE SEEMS DIFFERENT.
HE LOOKS SO SPACED
OUT ON DRY LAND...)

DO YOU KNOW HIM,
SHUICHI?

YEAH. MY FRIEND
NAGARE. HE'S THE ACE
OF GORIN HIGH'S SWIM
TEAM.

...SO HE'S A
THIRD-YEAR? HE LOOKS
A LITTLE OLDER THAN
THAT...

HE CHANGES IN WATER.
SPACED OUT ON LAND,
BUT SHARP THE MOMENT
HE ENTERS THE POOL.
...DO I?

...WEREN'T YOU
LOOKING FOR... THE
CLUB BUILDING...?

OH, THAT'S RIGHT. I
CAME TO LOOK AT THE
CLUBS.

IF YOU'RE CHOOSING A
CLUB, THEY'RE GIVING
TALKS OVER THERE.
YOU SHOULD GO.

I HANDLE SWIMMING
FOR ALL FIVE
SCHOOLS. I'LL BE
SEEING YOU.

THANK YOU. I HAVEN'T
CHOSEN YET. NAGARE,
ARE YOU THE COACH?

...SWIMMING... IS
RECOMMENDATION ONLY.
NO OPEN
MEMBERSHIP...

RIGHT. THE OTHER
CLUBS... OH, TWO
TEACHERS OVER THERE.
MR. OKITA! MR. GORO!

HEY, SAWAMURA.
SHOWING A NEW
STUDENT AROUND?
ALWAYS SO HELPFUL.

THIS IS MR. OKITA,
VOLLEYBALL COACH.
HE USED TO BE ON THE
NATIONAL TEAM!

HAHA! THAT'S ALL IN
THE PAST. I'M KOTARO
OKITA. LET'S AIM FOR
THE WORLD TOGETHER!

MR. GORO WAS A SUMO
WRESTLER. KNOW HIS
OLD RING NAME,
KANAYAMA?

THAT'S AN OLD STORY!
I'M GORO, SUMO COACH
YOUNGSTERS WOULDN'T
KNOW ME. HELLO!

{0} {1}.
NICE TO MEET YOU.

...SHOULDN'T YOU...
GET GOING? YOU'RE
JOINING A CLUB...?

OOPS, I TALKED TOO
LONG. SEE YOU,
{0}{1}{2}!

YOU'RE LATE! CLUB
ORIENTATION IS OVER.
WHAT WERE YOU DOING?

OH, CLASS REP. THE
CLUB PRESENTATIONS
ARE ALREADY OVER?

I'LL EXPLAIN.
FIRST, LET ME
INTRODUCE EACH
CLUB'S CONTACT.

THIS IS SAYURI, THE
DRAMA CLUB CAPTAIN.
AND KOZUE, THE ART
CLUB'S VICE CAPTAIN.

DO YOU LIKE DRAMA?
I'M SAYURI, DRAMA
CLUB CAPTAIN. NICE
TO MEET YOU!

I'M KOZUE. OUR ART
CLUB IS SMALL, BUT
IT'S A LOT OF FUN.
NICE TO MEET YOU!

SHIZUNE LEADS BAND.
MARI MANAGES SOCCER.
BOTH ARE FIRST-YEARS
JUST LIKE US.

...I'M SHIZUNE...
NICE TO MEET YOU.

I'M MARI NANASE. THE
PLAYERS JUST CALL ME
MARI. NICE TO MEET
YOU!

THERE ARE ALSO...
THREE TEACHERS AND
SOMEONE FROM THE
BASEBALL CLUB...

I MET MR. OKITA, MR.
GORO, AND SHUICHI
FROM THE BASEBALL
CLUB.

OH, THAT'S
CONVENIENT. THEN THE
LAST ONE IS...

NOW, NOW! YOU
FLATTER ME!

AH... SORRY, SIR.
THIS IS MR. KATO
FROM THE CHEMISTRY
CLUB.

DON'T CALL ME SIR.
CALL ME BAKA! I'M
THE CHEMISTRY CLUB'S
ADVISER. HELLO!

THAT'S EVERYONE.
THEY'LL EXPLAIN WHAT
EACH CLUB DOES.

I'LL EXPLAIN HOW
EACH CLUB AFFECTS
YOUR STATS.

LISTEN TO THE TALKS,
THEN DECIDE WHETHER
YOU'D LIKE TO JOIN.

YOU CAN CHANGE CLUBS
AT THE START OF THE
SECOND AND THIRD
TERMS, TOO.

WHICH CLUB WOULD YOU
LIKE TO HEAR ABOUT?

BASEBALL  VOLLEYBALL
SOCCER    SUMO
GO HOME   CULTURE >

ART       BAND
THEATER   CHEMISTRY
GO HOME   SPORTS >

BASEBALL'S CONTACT
IS SHUICHI, A KIND
FORMER ACE WHO
RETIRED WITH INJURY.

{0}STAM{1} RISES MOST.
{2}ATK{3} AND {4}GUTS{5} RISE.
{6}INT{7} FALLS A LITTLE.

JOIN THE BASEBALL
CLUB?

NO
YES

VOLLEYBALL'S COACH
IS MR. OKITA. HE'S
PASSIONATE, BUT NOT
QUITE LIKE HAYATO...

{0}ATK{1} AND {2}STAM{3} RISE,
WITH BALANCED GAINS.
NO PARTICULAR STATS
FALL SIGNIFICANTLY.

JOIN THE VOLLEYBALL
CLUB?

NO
YES

SOCCER. MARI IS IN
CHARGE. A FIRST-YEAR
MANAGER WHO NOTICES
EVERYTHING.

{0}DEF{1} RISES MOST.
GAINS ARE BALANCED.
NOTHING FALLS, BUT
{2}POT{3} GROWS SLOWLY.

TRY JOINING THE
SOCCER CLUB?

NO
YES

SUMO. MR. GORO IS AN
OUTSIDE COACH,
RATHER THAN A SCHOOL
TEACHER.

{0}ATK{1} RISES SHARPLY.
{2}DEF{3} RISES TOO.
BUT {4}INT{5} AND {6}POT{7}
BOTH GO DOWN...

TRY JOINING THE SUMO
CLUB?

NO
YES

ART. KOZUE IS THE
CONTACT. SHE SEEMS
FAR TOO RESPONSIBLE
TO BE A SECOND-YEAR!

{0}POT{1} RISES SHARPLY,
AND {2}INT{3} RISES A LOT.
OTHER STATS BARELY
CHANGE...
JOIN THE ART CLUB?

NO
YES

SHIZUNE LEADS BAND.
A QUIET FIRST-YEAR.
I'VE NEVER SEEN HER
ANGRY...

{0}DEF{1} RISES MOST.
{2}INT{3} AND {4}POT{5} RISE.
{6}ATK{7} FALLS SHARPLY.
OTHERWISE, SOLID.
JOIN THE BAND?

NO
YES

SAYURI LEADS DRAMA.
SHE'S A THIRD-YEAR.
HER FAN CLUBS REACH
EVEN OTHER SCHOOLS!

{0}GUTS{1} RISES MOST.
{2}POT{3} AND {4}INT{5} RISE.
BUT {6}ATK{7} AND {8}DEF{9}
BARELY RISE OR FALL.
JOIN THE DRAMA CLUB?

NO
YES

MR. KATO RUNS
CHEMISTRY. CALL HIM
BAKA, AS HE ASKED.
A NICE TEACHER, EH?

{0}INT{1} RISES MOST.
{2}POT{3} ALSO RISES.
OTHER STATS ARE
ABOUT AVERAGE.

JOIN THE CHEMISTRY
CLUB?

NO
YES

THE GO-HOME CLUB...
THERE'S NO COACH. IF
YOU LIKE, I CAN LOOK
AFTER YOU.

ITS STAT GAINS ARE
A COMPLETE MYSTERY.
TRY YOUR LUCK AND
SEE WHAT HAPPENS.

JOIN THE GO-HOME
CLUB? OR HEAR ABOUT
THE OTHER CLUBS
AGAIN?

NO
YES

CHANGED YOUR MIND?
CHOOSE WHICH CLUB
YOU WANT TO HEAR
ABOUT AGAIN.

ALL SET, THEN. ASK
YOUR CLUB'S CONTACT
FOR THE DETAILS. SEE
YOU.

NOW... I'LL EXPLAIN
GENERAL CLUB
ACTIVITIES. LET'S GO
TO A CLASSROOM.

WELCOME, {0}{1}{2}.
THOUGHT YOU'D COME.
HAVE A GOOD YEAR.
READY TO BEGIN?

LET'S TALK ABOUT
CLUB ACTIVITIES.
YOU'RE ALREADY IN A
CLUB, RIGHT?

HEAR THE EXPLANATION
SKIP IT

GOOD. FIRST,
REMEMBER THERE ARE
TWO KINDS OF CLUB
ACTIVITIES.

REGULAR ACTIVITIES,
AND SPECIAL TRAINING
AT THE START OF EACH
MONTH.

FIRST, REGULAR CLUB
ACTIVITIES. YOU
DON'T CHOOSE EXACTLY
WHAT TO DO.

WHILE YOU BELONG TO
A CLUB, ITS MAIN
STATS GRADUALLY
IMPROVE OVERALL.

YOU'LL SEE THE
RESULTS AT SPECIAL
TRAINING AT THE
START OF EACH MONTH.

REGULAR TRAINING IS
AUTOMATIC. NO EXTRA
EFFORT OR SLACKING,
BUT IT BUILDS STATS.

NEXT, SPECIAL
TRAINING: SESSIONS
HELD BY EACH CLUB AT
THE MONTH'S START.

EACH CLUB FOCUSES ON
TRAINING THAT SUITS
ITS OWN SPECIALTY.

SPECIAL TRAINING IS
MUCH MORE EFFICIENT
THAN REGULAR CLUB
ACTIVITIES.

TO RAISE ONE STAT A
GREAT DEAL, MAKE USE
OF THESE SPECIAL
TRAINING SESSIONS.

REGULAR ACTIVITIES
GIVE GENERAL GROWTH.
SPECIAL TRAINING
FOCUSES THAT GROWTH.

THAT'S ABOUT IT FOR
CLUB TRAINING.

SHALL I EXPLAIN IT
AGAIN?

NO, THANKS
HEAR IT AGAIN

GOOD. THAT CONCLUDES
TODAY'S CLUB
ORIENTATION.
